title: Juniper and Earthbake Crusted Pork Chops
description: Tender pork chops crusted in a mixture of earthy earthbake and fragrant juniper, perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Season pork chops with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
In a shallow dish, mix together crushed earthbake and juniper berries.
Dip each pork chop into the earthbake mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear pork chops for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let pork chops rest for 5 minutes before serving.
